none: PAS CAM-C8558A: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 307-361 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows two soldiers, one standard. Mint is Trier, AD 335-341. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a laureate bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(dot)TRS[...]. Die axis is 7 o'clock. Weight is 0.74g, diameter is 14.2mm, thickness is 1.2mm
